purpose: Prospective engineering comparison only. It is not a registration, a conversion of F4, a strict-gate sizing decision, or release evidence.

evidence_inventory.policy: Use only checked-in, published external development evidence that jointly identifies candidate-minus-B8 paired-delta variance by mix, full-pair cost by mix, and complete-session/whole-path cost components. Do not inspect protected outcome-artifact roots.

eligible_checked_in_inputs.scope: Three B8-only timing episodes (4.13-14.59 seconds); illustrative timing sensitivity only.
eligible_checked_in_inputs.reason: No candidate-minus-B8 paired deltas, mix variance/covariance, complete-pair costs, Watch session costs, or full-path cost accounting.

eligible_checked_in_inputs.scope: Documents approximately seven-hour operator wait and operational history.
eligible_checked_in_inputs.reason: It is not a joint paired-delta/cost calibration and cannot establish expected future complete-path savings.

evidence_inventory.frozen_consequence: Sensitivity only. The selection result is RETAIN_FIXED_DESIGN until a separately reviewed eligible evidence manifest changes this field before any scientific data.

cost_aware_fixed.estimator: G = sum(mean_delta_m)/3; Var(G) = sum(sigma_m^2/n_m)/9 for disjoint mix banks.
cost_aware_fixed.selection: Externally frozen only; never use interim winners, arrival order, or simulation outcomes.

futility_64_128.interim_action: FUTILE only when conditional probability is below 0.05; efficacy, alpha recycling, and a 32-world look are prohibited.

futility_model.distribution: Exact analytic Gaussian conditional-predictive model with independent disjoint mix banks, centered at the frozen remaining profile and using frozen marginal paired-delta SDs. Heavy-tailed Student-t outcomes are a separately reported outer operating-characteristic sensitivity, not an input to the conditional-probability calculation.
futility_model.nuisance: Frozen externally supplied mix SDs; no interim re-estimation. Disjoint mix banks are assumed for the mass statistic.
futility_model.conditional_probability: Condition on the observed 64-world mix means. The final equal-weight mean is Gaussian with mean one half observed equal-weight mean plus one half frozen remaining-profile mean and variance sum(sigma_m^2/64)/36. It passes iff it exceeds max(+40, t_0.90,nu times sqrt(sum(sigma_m^2/128)/9)), where nu is the frozen Welch-Satterthwaite df for the final 128/mix design.

synthetic_sensitivity_model.description: A standardized sensitivity scale used only to exercise frozen paired design comparisons while empirical calibration is absent. Homogeneous, heterogeneous, guard-boundary, partial-null, heavy-tail, and correlated scenarios have separately frozen generators. Fixed and futility paths share each simulated complete 128-world paired block, so the futility path is pathwise a subset of its fixed reference. It cannot support allocation or adoption.

complete_contract.survival_guard_a: survival band v2 against B8 s3: pooled margin -0.05 and single-mix margin -0.075
complete_contract.product: final complete paired Watch sessions with paired 95% product intervals; no interim product look
complete_contract.operational: strict gate and serving qualification remain separately registered Mac work

decision.monte_carlo: Report binomial 95% uncertainty for every probability and refuse adoption if either threshold remains unresolved.
decision.adoption_guard: No sensitivity result may return ADOPT_FOR_FUTURE_REGISTRATION. Only adequate empirical calibration, all frozen scenario results, valid error/guard argument, and a later Astra-judged registration can support an adoption recommendation.

compute.platform: Colab CPU only; do not use A100 or L4
compute.allocation_indices: Frozen lexicographic scenario IDs; deterministic one scenario per allocation index.
